```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(mirt)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r notes-front, results='asis'}
nt <- params$notes
.has <- function(k) is.list(nt) && !is.null(nt[[k]]) && nzchar(nt[[k]])
.p <- function(x) paste0("<p>", gsub("\n+", "</p><p>", htmltools::htmlEscape(trimws(x))), "</p>")
if (.has("title") || .has("authors")) {
  cat("<div class='report-cover'>")
  if (.has("title")) cat("<h1 class='report-title'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(nt$title), "</h1>", sep = "")
  if (.has("authors")) cat("<p class='report-authors'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(nt$authors), "</p>", sep = "")
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
for (sec in list(c("background", "Background"), c("objectives", "Objectives"), c("method", "Method"))) {
  if (.has(sec[1])) cat("## ", sec[2], "\n\n", .p(nt[[sec[1]]]), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Item Parameters (IRT)

```{r}
res <- params$lta_res
if(!is.null(res)){
  cfs <- coef(res, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)
  if(!is.null(cfs$items)){
    item_df <- as.data.frame(cfs$items)
    item_df$Item <- rownames(item_df)
    item_df <- item_df[, c(ncol(item_df), 1:(ncol(item_df)-1))]
    kable(item_df, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, digits = 3) %>% 
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
  }
} else {
  cat("No LTA/IRT results available.")
}
```

## Trace Lines Plot

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if(!is.null(res)){
  plot(res, type = "trace")
}
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

}
```

```{r notes-back, results='asis'}
for (sec in list(c("results", "Interpretation of the Results"), c("conclusion", "Conclusion"), c("limits", "Limitations and Recommendations"))) {
  if (.has(sec[1])) cat("## ", sec[2], "\n\n", .p(nt[[sec[1]]]), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

  cat("## AI Interpretive Summary\n\n")

  cat("\n</div>\n\n")
}
